name: Veil Masquerade #16
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Loops. Aperture: Slot. Ornament: Spirals. Palette: Lilac. Hem: Pointed fringe. Its hem is the only one of its kind in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
